answer_criteria.instruction: A note IS selected but the user keeps it private from the AI. Acknowledge the note the user means ("this note" or "the selected note") and say it is private (unavailable to the AI), without naming which privacy setting or rule hides it (no blacklist, whitelist or password protection). Do not say it is unselected, ask to select it again, ask for a password, or ask to paste/reveal its content. Do not claim to know its content.

expectation.reference_facts: A note IS selected but the AI privacy blacklist blocks its content, possibly through an ancestor. Explicitly say it is selected and blacklisted. Do not say it is unselected, ask to select it again, or ask to paste/reveal its content. Do not claim to know the content or invent the matching blacklist rule. No note content, title, tags, or ID was supplied.
